Name: AudioDuck
Author: xenside
Description: Per-app audio ducking: when one app plays (e.g. Discord), others get quieter. Runs while Stream Deck runs. The key pauses or resumes ducking and shows whether it is paused, active or ducking right now; its settings hold the rules, live levels and timings.

Actions.Name: Ducking
Actions.Tooltip: Pause or resume ducking. Rules and timings are in the key settings.

Actions.Name: Regola
Actions.Tooltip: Disable or re-enable one ducking rule.
